events.title: Pisgah Rage Pre-season
events.description: Runs 15 Oct 2026 to 31 Dec 2026. Pre-season activities including social events, rider assessment, bike shop night, parent meeting, and adventure rides in Bent Creek or Dupont

events.title: Pisgah Rage Regular Season
events.description: Runs 1 Dec 2026 to 30 May 2027. Regular season with practices and races. January: 2-4 indoor training opportunities. February: 1 weekend practice per week (2 hours). March-May: 2 rides per week (1-2 weeknights after 5pm for 1.5 hours, weekend practices on alternating Saturdays/Sundays for 2 hours). Races start in March with 5-6 races across North Carolina through May
